svg.title: One linked-data model for web markup, evidence and qualified authority
svg.desc: Web markup (schema.org in JSON-LD), a verifiable evidence graph and qualified authority edges share one data model. The qualified layer shows the graph-proof profile proposed in Section 9.

rdf:Alt.rdf:li: One linked-data model for web markup, evidence and qualified authority
Web markup (schema.org in JSON-LD), a verifiable evidence graph and qualified authority edges share one data model. The qualified layer shows the graph-proof profile proposed in Section 9.
